name: Zionskirche
sourceEnvelopeOwner: Alt-Mitte v169 existing complete source shells

primarySources.facts: 67 m tower; protected brick-terracotta church in Neo-Romanesque style.
Short Latin-cross plan; front tower; large semicircular apse; Lombard round-arch portal and dwarf galleries; open upper tower stages and octagonal crown.
Light-banded brick; galleries above round-arched tracery windows; square lower tower and octagonal belfry.

visualReferences.author: Ansgar Koreng
visualReferences.use: Reference only: tall masonry octagonal spire, blind panels, ribs, roundels, upper belfry arcades and finial. No pixels bundled.

visualReferences.author: Roland Arhelger
visualReferences.use: Reference only: clocks, portal, pale masonry bands, columned paired belfry arches, dwarf gallery and lower front. No pixels bundled.

sourceConflicts: LoD2 ends at 48.126 m. Retain its complete geometry; add only the missing upper crown to the published 67 m total using unsurveyed photographic proportions. Existing generic facade details remain behind thin new source-plane masonry backing. No source packet is changed.
